statement:
∀ {E : Type ?u.3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type ?u.4} [DecidableEq ι]
  (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → E), Orthonormal ℝ e → ∀ (f : E), ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2 ≤ ‖f‖ ^ 2

goal.text: ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2 ≤ ‖f‖ ^ 2
goal.lhs: ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2

atoms: ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (e i) f ^ 2
